issues_detected.title: Warped and Discolored Flooring
issues_detected.description: The hardwood flooring is visibly warped and discolored, indicating potential water damage.
issues_detected.recommendation: Investigate and repair any sources of moisture. Replace damaged flooring and ensure proper sealing to prevent future issues.

analysis.overall_assessment: The flooring shows significant signs of water damage, requiring immediate attention to prevent further deterioration.
